findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The coffee machine dispenser was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on it. CORRECTED- The dispenser was cleaned during the inspection and it was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: The facility is observed to not have a probe thermometer. This was discussed with the PIC. There needs to always be a probe thermometer available to measure the internal temperatures of foods and to properly monitor cooling and reheating. A follow up is scheduled for 9/8/2026 to ensure a probe thermometer is available.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: There is observed to not be any allergen labeling on the breakfast buffet, including on the muffins, the bread case, and the cereal dispensers. On bulk food that is available for consumer self-dispensing and on buffet items, there should be a label that communicates the major allergens in the product to the consumer. This can be accomplished through a poster, QR code, magnets, images, or labeling on the cases. Ensure that all buffet items are labeled with their major allergens by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-602.11(C) Food Labels. (C) Bulk FOOD that is available for CONSUMER self-dispensing shall be prominently labeled with the following information in plain view of the CONSUMER: (1) The manufacturer's or processor's label that was provided with the FOOD; or (2) A card, sign, or other method of notification that includes the information specified under Subparagraphs (B)(1), (2), (5) and (6) of this section.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There was observed to not be sanitizer made and available to wipe down food-contact surfaces. CORRECTED- A sanitizer bucket was made and tested to be at 100ppm of Chlorine. Ensure that there is always sanitizer made and available during food preparation and service to sanitize food-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: The mop bucket was observed to have used mop water in it in the back room. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the employee and the waste water was discarded. Ensure that mop water is immediately discarded of after use to prevent pest harborage conditions.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the back room is observed to be in need of being sealed to the wall. This was discussed with an employee. Ensure that this is sealed and made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were lemons and a towel in the handwashing sink in the back room. CORRECTED- The towel and lemons were removed and the PIC was educated that handwashing sinks should only be used for their intended purpose of handwashing. Ensure that all employees are educated on making sure that handwashing sinks are only used for handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The handwashing sink in the back room did not have any paper towels at it. CORRECTED- The employee placed paper towels at the handwashing sink. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are supplied with individual, disposable towels to allow for proper handwashing. Paper towels are needed for the use of a barrier when turning off the faucet after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: FIRST REPEAT- Observed no certified food manager on duty while food is being served. A CFPM must be on duty at facility at all times that food is prepared or served. This is a repeat violation from the November 2023 inspection. The facility and owner will receive a warning letter regarding this repeat violation. 

 (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: The facility did not have reporting agreements for staff available. Facility was given reporting agreements to have all employees sign. Food employees should be informed of their responsibility to report information about their health related to disease transmissible through food. A follow up will be conducted on 8/26/2024 to ensure that reporting agreements for all staff have been signed and are available. 

(O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: The facility did not have a Norovirus cleanup policy or bodily fluid cleanup kit available. CORRECTED- Facility was given the Norovirus cleanup policy and they possess bleach to properly complete the process. 

 A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: The handwashing sink in the back room did not have paper towels at it. Ensure that all handwashing sinks have paper towels to allow proper handwashing and turning off of the faucet with a barrier. CORRECTED- The handwashing sink was stocked with paper towels by an employee. 

Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: There was not an air thermometer in the refrigerator in the dining area. Ensure that all refrigerated or hot food storage units have a thermometer to measure the air temperature. CORRECTED- The operator placed a thermometer in the refrigerator. 

 (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: The facility did not have a sanitizer bucket made. Ensure that a sanitizer bucket is available for use. Facility has been using a peroxide cleaner and was educated on how to properly make a sanitizer bucket and how to test it using their Chlorine test strips. Operator was also educated on proper storage of washing cloths regarding the sanitizer bucket. 

(B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: There is bare wood on the wall behind the handwashing sink. Ensure that all bare wood is sealed to prevent any absorbing of moisture. All materials indoor should be smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. 

 (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no certified food manager on duty while food is being served. A CFPM must be on duty at facility at all times that food is prepared or served. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Observed facility operating as a medium risk facility, while only possessing a low risk permit. Discussed issue with owner. Facility will switch to a medium risk permit. 

3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Observed no date marking on open gallon milk container in cooler. Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date). Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  Reference 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430.
